description_for_human: Browse trade collections, view trade tier pricing, and stage furniture or artwork directly into project workflows like the Singapore GCB or Hamptons folders.
description_for_model: Maison Affluency trade portal extension. Use this plugin to retrieve the member's active project folders and to stage catalogue products (furniture, artwork, lighting) into a chosen project workflow. Staged pieces are written to the portal dashboard database after server-side verification.

function.name: get_synced_projects
function.description: Returns the member's active project folders synced with the extension, such as 'Singapore GCB workflow' and 'Hamptons Project'. Call this before staging any product so the target workflow name matches an existing folder.

limit.description: Maximum number of active project folders to return. Defaults to all active folders.

projectId.description: Stable UUID of the project workflow in the portal database.

name.description: Display name of the project folder, e.g. 'Singapore GCB workflow'.

synced.description: True when the folder shares real-time data hooks with the extension.

function.name: stage_product_to_project
function.description: Stages a catalogue product (furniture, artwork, lighting) into one of the member's active project workflows, executing the verified data handshake back to the main dashboard database. Call get_synced_projects first to resolve a valid targetWorkflow.

productId.description: Stable UUID of the trade catalogue product to stage.

productName.description: Display name of the product exactly as shown in the catalogue, e.g. 'Casque Bar Cabinet'.

targetWorkflow.description: Exact name of the destination project folder, e.g. 'Singapore GCB workflow' or 'Hamptons Project'.

status.description: 'staged' when the record was written and verified, 'rejected' when validation failed.

boardItemId.description: UUID of the created board item record, present when status is 'staged'.

targetWorkflow.description: Name of the project folder the product was staged into.

message.description: Human-readable result, e.g. 'Success: Casque Bar Cabinet added to Singapore GCB workflow'.
